mapper.select: SELECT visit_type, COUNT(*) as visitCount FROM kb_doc_visit_record WHERE del_flag = '0' AND doc_id = #{docId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY visit_type
SELECT visit_type, COUNT(*) as visitCount FROM kb_doc_visit_record WHERE del_flag = '0' AND user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY visit_type

SELECT v.visit_id, v.doc_id, v.folder_id, v.visit_type, v.keywords, v.keywords_max, v.source_ip, v.user_id, v.device_type, v.browser, v.referer, v.duration_seconds, v.create_time, d.doc_name, d.doc_title FROM kb_doc_visit_record v LEFT JOIN kb_doc d ON v.doc_id = d.doc_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE v.del_flag = '0' AND v.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY v.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(create_time) as statDate, COUNT(*) as visitCount FROM kb_doc_visit_record WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY statDate DESC
